title: Findings
description: Result of one change request after finalize: the verdict and everything the report and the publish plan are built from.

cr.description: Change request the result belongs to.

verdict.description: BLOCKED when at least one publishable BLOCKER comes from the change request itself (in findings, not preExisting) or at least one existing defect is a crash; OK otherwise. MAJOR, MINOR and INFO findings never block. The plugin never approves; OK only means nothing blocks. The verdict of the whole cascade is not stored here.

summary.description: Overall remarks from the judgement, in Markdown.

findings.description: Findings that count towards the verdict.

preExisting.description: Defects already on the target branch, reported apart.

notVerified.description: Changed files that were not reviewed, and why.

items.description: One file that was not reviewed.

path.description: File path in the change request.

reason.description: generated: marked as generated; binary: no text diff; patch-unavailable: the platform omitted the diff; noise: matches a noise glob; unsupported-language: no pack covers it; match-budget-exceeded: a rule ran out of matching steps on the file, and detail names the rule.

detail.description: Optional human-readable detail; required for match-budget-exceeded, where it names the rule.

ci.description: State of the checks on the head commit when the change request was collected.

state.description: failing if any check failed, else pending if any is not completed, passing if all passed, none if the head has no checks, unknown when the checks could not be read. A head whose checks could not be read is never reported as none.

reason.description: Why the checks could not be read: forbidden when the platform denied access, error for any other failure. Present if and only if state is unknown.

detail.description: Optional human-readable detail about the state, for example the platform's error message.

checks.description: Every check on the head commit; empty when state is none or unknown.

conclusion.description: Outcome of a completed check; null while it is not completed.

criteria.description: Criteria the change request was reviewed with, always read from the target branch.

notes.description: Notes for the summary, for example that the change request edits its own criteria and the edit was not applied.

criteriaSource.description: Where the criteria come from: overlay is .agent-code-review/, legacy is .github/skills and .github/mr-review.json, default is the packs alone.

line.description: Line number, starting at 1, in the file version of the chosen side.

packId.description: Stack pack identifier, for example android or kotlin-multiplatform.

profile.description: Kind of repository, which selects the default criteria.

reference.description: Another place in the code that a finding relies on, possibly in another project.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit SHA the line refers to.

relativePath.description: Relative path with forward slashes, without empty, '.' or '..' segments.

reportedFinding.description: A finding after finalization, with its fingerprint and placement.

id.description: Stable fingerprint of the finding, used to avoid posting it twice.

path.description: File path in the change request; for a removed file, its old path.

side.description: Diff side that line and startLine refer to.

startLine.description: First line of a finding that spans several lines; absent for a single line.

message.description: Explanation in Markdown: what is wrong, why it matters, how to fix it.

title.description: What is wrong, in one line.

why.description: The consequence: what goes wrong if the code ships as it is, in Markdown.

fix.description: The smallest safe correction, in Markdown. A finding without a fix is not a finding.

suggestion.description: Replacement text for the lines from startLine (or line) to line, without a trailing newline.

references.description: Other places the finding relies on.

crash.description: True when the defect makes the app crash. Meaningful only in preExisting: an existing defect that crashes the app makes the change request BLOCKED. On findings of the change request it is rejected later by the judgement validation.

placement.description: Where the finding is published: inline on the diff, or in the summary when its lines are outside the diff.

ruleId.description: Rule identifier: lowercase words joined by hyphens, optionally in dot-separated groups, for example no-double-bang.

severity.description: Severity of a finding, from the most to the least serious.

sha.description: Full commit SHA, 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

side.description: Side of the diff: LEFT is the target branch version, RIGHT the change request version.
